candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, or crash) not established; payment metrics excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory/reservations succeed (200) while payment returns 503, propagating 502 through order to gateway checkout. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s including /readyz, indicating payment is the failing hop. Root cause within payment is not yet bounded.
missing_evidence: Payment service error logs / stack traces explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations and /readyz
Payment service metrics (excluded) to distinguish saturation vs. misconfiguration
